summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, the team is preparing for the release of Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0 and is planning the Iceberg Summit 2027 while addressing various technical proposals and strategies.
highlights: Integration efforts with Spark: variant support and DSv2 API upgrades
Preparation for Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0 release
Proposals for global snapshot consistency and finer grained read restrictions
